data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"18 is the smallest positive solution, obtained by overlaying the two periodic remainder sequences and locating their first simultaneous match.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the two periodic sequences have a match at some x < 18, the overlay analysis is overturned.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the combined period is not 35, the periodic intersection set is incomplete.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Define two periodic functions on the positive integers: f(x) = x mod 5 and g(x) = x mod 7, with periods 5 and 7. Their combined pattern has period lcm(5,7) = 35. Within one full period {1, ..., 35}, f(x) = 3 at x \u2208 {3, 8, 13, 18, 23, 28, 33} and g(x) = 4 at x \u2208 {4, 11, 18, 25, 32}.
